subject: department management
scenario: An organization whose departments are managed by humans is not autonomous: a person sits in the middle of every departmental rollup. The human's authority must be real and narrow - governance and approval - not operational management.
expected_behaviors: Every department is headed by an agent, and the head can spawn its own lead.
Every human_owner names specific authority, and is never an agent.
Escalation runs worker to peer to lead to head to human_owner, in that order.
Any human-headed department argues the exception explicitly.
failure_conditions: A human receives routine departmental rollups.
A human_owner is an agent, or decides nothing specific.
A head cannot delegate to its own lead.

checks.pattern: The operational manager of a department is an agent
